# Islamic Organisation for Food Security

> > IOFS is an OIC specialized institution dedicated to eradicating global hunger through sustainable agriculture, capacity-building, and food security initiatives across member states.

The Islamic Organisation for Food Security (IOFS) is headquartered in Astana, Kazakhstan, and serves as a multilateral organization under the Organisation of Islamic Cooperation (OIC). It focuses on agricultural development, food crisis response, and resource mobilization across OIC member states and beyond.

## Key Topics

- Food Security
- Sustainable Agriculture
- Capacity Building
- OIC Member States
- Agricultural Development
- Food Crisis Response
- Water Management
- Governance
- Resource Mobilization
- Humanitarian Aid
- Farmer Training
- Africa Initiative
- Afghanistan Program
- Halal & Safe Food Ecosystem
- International Cooperation
